audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to Cho'Gath's Q calls it "Rupture (Knockup)". The ability is called Rupture; the parenthetical is a generator artifact and it is displayed to the player.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/chogath.json gives the name as Rupture. The suffix appears in focus.text, loading, breakdown.wave, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad, dosFull, dontsFull and four report rows.
audit.corrected: Removed wherever the fixed-length band allowed, including focus.text.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Cho'Gath burns Rupture on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation" and "sidestep it and he has no engage at all".
audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6-second cooldown at EVERY rank and casts at 950. Dodging it buys six seconds, and it reaches as far as Radiant Volley does — he is not rangeless and the lane is not free.
audit.corrected: Corrected to six seconds and threaded the 950 range through tldr, winCon, phases[0].why, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.early and content whys[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Feral Scream's silence is the single most dangerous thing in this matchup for Mel and neither layer gives its range or cooldown.
audit.why: Mel's entire output is abilities — Radiant Volley, Solar Snare, Golden Eclipse and the Searing Brilliance stacking all stop under a silence. Feral Scream is a 300-range cone on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 seconds, so the counterplay is purely spacing.
audit.corrected: Made it the enemyWin line and added the numbers to tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[2].why, dontsFull[2].d and content wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Content describes Feast as "true-damage percent-HP" against Mel in four places.
audit.why: Riot's text for Feast is "deals a high amount of true damage". A percent-of-max-health component against a champion is not stated there, and the derived percentHealth flag is not enough to assert it. What is certain and decisive is that it is true damage, so resistances are the wrong purchase.
audit.corrected: Rewrote to the true-damage / resistances-do-nothing framing and added the 175 cast range, which is the actual reason distance is the counter.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content's early section says "his only sustain is Feast stacks he doesn't have yet".
audit.why: Carnivore restores health and mana whenever he kills any unit, and it is online from level 1 and scales with his level. A Cho'Gath who is still farming is sustaining through the poke the whole time.
audit.corrected: Added to phases[3].why. The early paragraph itself was left alone because a correction that fits inside +/-10% would have had to drop something else true.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vorpal Spikes is never mentioned in either layer.
audit.why: On an 8/7/6/5/4-second cooldown his basic attacks release spikes that damage and slow everything in front of him. It is why standing in his facing arc during a trade costs more than an auto-attack should.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr read "Free stacking lane — every Q volley builds your execute while he farms politely."
audit.why: He does not farm politely. Rupture matches Mel's own poke range at 950 on a six-second cycle, Carnivore sustains him through the chip, and one Feral Scream inside 300 removes her entire kit.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the range and cooldown facts.

audit.whatIsWrong: "your only defensive layer is gone for twenty seconds" understates Rebuttal by roughly half.
audit.corrected: Corrected to 38 seconds at rank 1 in tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d, phases[1].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Itemization row ended "Add anti-heal early into his sustain" with no mention that his ultimate ignores the defensive stats the same row recommends.
audit.why: Feast is true damage. Armour and magic resist do not reduce it at all, so the usual tank-answer instinct is wrong here.
audit.corrected: Replaced the tail with the true-damage warning. Carnivore's healing is real, so anti-heal is not wasted — but it was already the only thing the row said, and the resistance point is the more decisive one.

notes:
GENERATOR ROOT CAUSE: champ-data/_gen-engine.js line 119 reads  chogath: { slot:'Q', name:'Rupture (Knockup)', cd:'6s', note:'Telegraphed knockup — sidestep it and he has no engage at all.' }.  The cooldown is right, but the name carries a "(Knockup)" suffix that is not part of the ability name and that ships to the player, and the note asserts he has no engage — Rupture reaches 950, matching Mel's own Radiant Volley, on a six-second flat cycle. Both propagate to every owner's Cho'Gath entry. I did not touch _gen-engine.js.

The "fifteen-second invitation" template is separately wrong here: the sentence is generated for whatever ability is in focus, and against a 6-second flat cooldown it overstates the window by 150%.

Sample size: MC_REAL_GAMES.mel.chogath is 10 games. 40% is 4 wins in 10.

Kit-flag false positive I deliberately did NOT write from: Rupture carries a derived "grounding" flag, which comes from the phrase "Ruptures the ground" in Riot's text. Rupture knocks up and slows; it does not ground. Nothing in these proposals asserts grounding.

Deliberately not asserted: that Feast deals percent-max-health damage to champions. Riot's description says only "a high amount of true damage", and the derived percentHealth flag is not a source. The content layer currently states percent-HP in four places; I corrected the ones I edited to the true-damage framing and left the rest, but a human should check the League Wiki and settle it — it changes whether stacking health is the right answer.
